data.narrative:
PLD Space is a SPAC-stage aerospace company in the Space & Aerospace sector that has raised €120M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space, though direct peer matching is constrained by stage and scale heterogeneity.

Conventional triangulation methods yield limited applicability here. Peer-Median valuation cannot be executed: while 14 same-sector peers exist, filtering for matching stage and valuation tier yields fewer than 3 datapoints, rendering sector-wide fallbacks unreliable. Public-Comp Anchoring is similarly blocked by the absence of disclosed revenue for the target; the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 27.4x P/S across the 6 tickers identified, but this multiple cannot be applied without revenue visibility.

The analysis reveals a structural gap rather than a valuation range. PLD Space's position as a SPAC-stage company in a sector populated by both capital-intensive incumbents (SpaceX, Rocket Lab) and earlier-stage ventures limits comparable-driven approaches. Resolution requires either (1) disclosure of forward revenue or EBITDA guidance sufficient for multiples-based anchoring, or (2) access to transaction-level pricing from recent Space & Aerospace SPAC mergers or equity rounds. Until those inputs surface, traditional quantitative triangulation remains inoperable.
